description: Narrow calibration pass for Magic and Monsters. Restores current WPN-supported Friday Commander Free Play as dated, check-first inventory while preserving the venue's lower-confidence source-health caveat and inactive historical weekly row.
author: Codex Project Steward

fields.title: Commander Free Play
fields.details: Wizards/EventLink store 7807 still shows Friday 6:00 PM Commander Free Play at Magic and Monsters on July 24 and July 31, 2026 with free entry and 48-player capacity. Venue identity is safe enough because the WPN store name and Mission Viejo address match the existing venue, but store-controlled sources remain contradictory: the official calendar showed no MTG listings in checked future pages and the inspected Discord summer schedule said Magic is no longer on the regular weekly schedule. Capture these checked dates as verify/check-first inventory rather than projecting a reliable ongoing weekly lane.

operations.reason: Capture current source-supported events even when the venue/source picture is messy, while limiting the write to the checked WPN date window rather than over-projecting a weekly recurrence.

fields.assessment_notes: Magic and Monsters remains a real TCG-focused Mission Viejo store with unusually good source routing, but it is still a weaker personal MTG planning target than its generic WPN listing suggests. Under the narrower 2026-07-24 calibration, the app should carry the currently checked WPN-supported Friday Commander Free Play dates for July 24 and July 31 as medium-confidence, verify-before-going inventory because the venue identity is safe enough. Store-controlled evidence still cuts against treating that lane as a reliable weekly anchor: the official web calendar showed no MTG listings in checked future pages, and the inspected Discord's May 31, 2026 summer schedule says Magic is no longer on the regular weekly schedule. Treat the venue as watch/special-event oriented rather than a dependable structured weekly Magic destination.

operations.reason: Shift from suppressing current WPN-backed events toward carrying them with honest caveats.
